title: Stamp Duty (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE STAMP DUTY ACT, NO. 43 of 1982

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Stamp Duty (Amendment) Act, No. 38 of 1996.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Stamp Duty (Amendment) Act, No. 38 of 1996.

body.heading: Amendment of section 5 of Act, No. 43 of 1982.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 5 of the Stamp Duty Act, No. 43 of 1982 (hereinafter referred to as the "principal enactment"), as last amended by Act No. 63 of 1993, is hereby further amended as follows;-

body.heading: Retrospective effect.
body.raw_text: 3. The amendment made to section 5 of the principal enactment, by section 2 of this Act shall be deemed for all purposes to have come into force on November 7,1996.

body.heading: Sinhala text to prevail in case of inconsistency.
body.raw_text: 4. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
